items.html: And afterwards, when the First Temple was built by Solomon, another aspect was added in her: that whether on Shabbat or on weekdays, she was always with him face to face, in the sixth aspect. However, the seventh aspect, which is the two kings using one crown, as above, was not so — not ever, until the future; and had it been so in the First Temple, no nation or language would have ruled over us at all.
